planting.note: a statistical device; real planting is limited by field workability, not by a 19 C running mean

window.rule: both ends are regressions on observed NASS pod-setting and leaf-drop dates, moved by a county-relative driver anomaly
window.note: every driver beats the plain average leaf-drop date by about 10%, and the record cannot choose between them; they agree that warm seasons make the window slightly LONGER

limits: interannual slopes extrapolated far beyond the observed range
county-relative anomalies: every county's mean window ends on the same date, since NASS has no county maturity data
